individual-data-points.explanation: Stacked bar/area chart showing median state frequencies across continuous, ordered ChIP-seq bins (a trend visualization similar to a stacked line/area plot across thousands of promoters); overlaying individual data points is not practical or required for this plot type.

error-bars-defined.explanation: The stacked bars show only median state frequencies per bin; no error bars or whiskers are displayed.

individual-data-points.explanation: This is a heatmap-like single-molecule stack where each row already represents an individual molecule's methylation status, so it inherently displays the raw individual data rather than an average.

error-bars-defined.explanation: This is a per-molecule methylation heatmap with percentage annotations; no error bars or box-plot elements are present.
